bash <script>.how: names how the install script is run, in prose; scenarios.py's install scenario runs it

cp -R assets/<part>/. <project>/.how: Copying assets/core/. into an empty directory: the copy has the dotfiles (.gitignore, .weaver.toml) and scripts/, and git diff --no-index with the asset shows nothing

gh api repos/<owner>/<repo> --jq .privat.how: Against a public and a private repo: prints false and true

gh api repos/open-telemetry/semantic-con.how: Prints the core registry's latest release tag, vX.Y.Z (v1.45.0 when checked)

gh api repos/open-telemetry/weaver/commi.how: Prints the full commit sha a weaver release tag points at: v0.28.0 gives 51a5bf95bdbb2e20fb6e16638e6bbe7dde911e93, the setup-weaver pin

gh api repos/open-telemetry/weaver/relea.how: Prints the newest weaver release tag (vX.Y.Z); needs the quotes as written, or zsh globs the brackets

gh run watch.how: names a tool or subcommand in prose; not an invocation to run

git diff --no-index <asset> <copy>.how: On a copied base file: shows only the replaced tokens and deleted sections

make package.how: the glossary names another part's target; not an invocation to run

rg --hidden --glob '!.git'.how: Verify item 1's search over a project: finds @@ tokens in dotfiles, and nothing under .git

weaver registry check.how: names a tool or subcommand in prose; not an invocation to run
